title: Updates the default value for shipping address validation
summary: Lets you more accurately track the status of physical card shipments, ensuring you know when a card has been submitted for shipping. Additionally, the updated default for shipping address validation—validation_and_normalization—automatically validates and normalizes addresses, reducing the likelihood of shipment errors and improving delivery success rates. This change introduces a new default value.

migrationNotes.text: Increase the address validation process by generating an error for physical card shipping addresses that are likely undeliverable.
